## Script

### SCORE and EMPHASIS lines per beat
<a id="l10-storyboard-score-emphasis"></a>

The source creator's storyboard ("claude-editing / storyboard, v2, 24 beats") gives each beat timecodes, duration, shot type, the spoken line, a direction, an EMPHASIS line (which word goes gold serif, which is struck through) and a SCORE line with music cues such as "drop 1 on 'Claude did.'" and "tape stop under the scratch 0:28.3, drop 2 on 'storyboard'".

**How:** Add two fields to every storyboard row: EMPHASIS (word + treatment) and SCORE (music event + the exact word it lands on).

> SCORE: drop 1 on 'Claude did.'

## Sound

### A sound on every visual event
<a id="sound-sfx-every-event"></a>

An edit without SFX feels like a "silent movie": put a pop, click, whoosh or snap on every visual change.

**How:** Edits/CapCut: Audio → Sound effects; or place CC0 files from Openverse; Real SFX skill auto-places them.

> Pop / click / whoosh / snap on every visual change

### Quiet music bed near −22 to −24 dB
<a id="sound-quiet-bed-throughout"></a>

A low ambient synth (L01) or lo-fi/chill-hop (L06) bed runs under the whole video; Oren's sits at about −22 to −24 dB under the voice, with SFX on top.

**How:** CapCut: music volume low and duck under voice; ffmpeg: volume=-22dB on the bed, or sidechaincompress keyed by the voice.

> Low ambient synth bed throughout

### Broadcast voice: compress, de-ess, high-pass
<a id="sound-broadcast-voice-chain"></a>

Close mic, tight compression, heavy de-essing, high-pass filter, air boost around 10–12 kHz, proximity low end, room reverb removed.

**How:** ffmpeg: highpass=f=80, acompressor=threshold=-18dB:ratio=3, deesser, equalizer=f=11000:t=h:w=2000:g=3, afftdn for room noise.

> Broadcast chain: tight compression, air boost at ~10–12 kHz, proximity low end, heavy de-essing, room reverb removed

### Mix measured at −14 LUFS
<a id="sound-loudness-minus-14"></a>

All 12 Rahul reels measured −14 LUFS with a 2.2–4.8 LU range (heavily compressed). The quietest 5% sits 9–21 dB under speech, never silent, pointing to a constant low bed (inferred).

**How:** ffmpeg: loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=4 (two-pass); check with ebur128.

> integrated loudness is −14 LUFS on all 12

### Half-second music dropout after the punchline
<a id="l10-dropout-after-punchline"></a>

Right after the hook line "Claude did." the whole mix drops to near-silence (-42 LUFS) for about 0.5 s at 2.50 s, then the beat returns. The rest of the 85 s has no silence at all.

**How:** Cut the music (and room tone) for 0.4-0.6 s directly after the punchline word, then bring the beat back on the next line. CapCut: split the music and delete the 0.5 s piece.
